errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that darker shades correspond to higher participant counts. The darkest shade (dark purple) corresponds to the highest value (6), but the second darkest (dark blue) corresponds to 5, and lighter shades (teal and green) correspond to lower values (3, 2, 1). The mapping is not strictly consistent with darkness and value.
